create_sqlite_logger_env: create a SynchronousSqliteLogger wrapper to log LLVM environment state transitions to an SQLite database
configure_commit_frequency: configure the SynchronousSqliteLogger commit frequency and max step buffer length for database writes
flush_buffered_records: flush buffered state and observation records from the SynchronousSqliteLogger to the SQLite database
record_state_transitions: record benchmark state transitions including actions, observations, and rewards to the database
close_logger_connection: close the SynchronousSqliteLogger by flushing pending records and closing the underlying environment
